units.source_text: 这是二十年前的往事了。
也许是她的父母当时不仅觉得生双胞胎无脸见人，

en.t: Perhaps her parents at the time felt not only that giving birth to twins was too shameful to face people,

units.source_text: 而且听说双胞胎难养，还考虑到生活问题，

en.t: but had also heard that twins were hard to raise, and took their living circumstances into account,

units.source_text: 所以才把千重子抛弃吧。

en.t: and that must be why they abandoned Chieko.
